answer: Give each identity a private canary: its challenge carries one invented detail, say a landmark called Ivory Knoll, that no other account is shown. If that detail turns up in another identity's answer, both get flagged, the way a mapmaker's trap street exposes a copied atlas. It only catches operators who batch identities through shared context; fully isolated sessions slip past at extra cost. Illustratively, a 5% leak per epoch gives about 79% detection over 30 epochs. An honest agent could mirror a canary quoted publicly, so a flag means review, not a slash.
